name: Runemaster audit #2732: Ancient Teachings gives melee haste and boosts Etching of the Dextrous
contract: Ancient Teachings rank1 705558: 'Increases haste by 3%.' Rank2 806797: 'Increases the effectiveness of
Etching of the Dextrous by 20%.' Re-verified in Spell.dbc: rank1 Effect1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE
(192), EffectBasePoints1 2 with DieSides 1 = +3% (its Effect0 dummy and Effect2 HASTE_SPELLS fields are not

effect value by 20% over a 1000 base.
